conviction_note: Non-result: NG is a pre-revenue developer whose print-day moves in the baseline (-14.1% on 2026-06-24, +15.0% on 2025-10-01) were gold-price days, not results days (Kalkine on 06-24: no company-specific catalyst); the only company-level items are a probably wider loss against a disputed -$0.06 to -$0.09 bar and management commentary on the 2026-09-23 draft SEIS, which roughly offset, so p_up is 50 and the scaled number is 0 while abs_move stays at about 5.5% because gold moves the stock either way.
bar: Q3 FY26 (quarter to 2026-08-31) EPS consensus quoted at -$0.06 (StockTwits), -$0.07 (Earnings Whispers), -$0.08 and -$0.09 (other aggregators) per a search over https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/x/NG and https://www.benzinga.com/quote/NG/earnings-forecasts; the sources disagree, so the bar is disputed and every finding is capped small. No revenue; the company's own guide is the approved $131.4m Donlin 2026 budget (100% basis) and the BFS by 2027 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1173420/000117184326004278/0001171843-26-004278-index.htm, Q2 release 2026-06-24).
positioning_check: Short interest 5.96% of float, 4.5 days to cover, settlement 2026-09-15 (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NYSEAMERICAN/NG/short-interest/, via sweep row): not crowded. Baseline skew_25d is null; put/call OI 0.46 (call-heavy); ATM spread 40% of mid, so the 6.43% event-implied move is indicative only. Stock -21.05% over 20 days, -54.96% from the 52-week high, alongside a gold sell-off (spot near $4,180 at 2026-09-30).

findings.finding: The Q3 loss (June-August 2026) should be wider than Q2's $25.5m: NG's 60% share of Donlin BFS spend ran $10.4m above the prior year in Q2 at the $131.4m 2026 budget, and the quarter also carries advisory and legal costs of the Paulson arrangement signed 2026-07-21 (Citi fairness opinion, Kingsdale and Innisfree proxy solicitation), so an optical EPS miss against the -$0.06 to -$0.08 bar is more likely than a beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Loss lines have not moved the stock on their own: the -14.13% on 2026-06-24 coincided with a sharp gold drop and Kalkine found no company-specific catalyst (https://kalkine.com/news/mining/novagold-resources-nyseamericanng-falls-more-than-14-as-gold-prices-drop-sharply); a 2025 Q2 loss-widening miss came with -5.13% on a weak gold day.
findings.why_not_priced: Aggregator consensus spans -$0.06 to -$0.09, which suggests some estimates were never updated for the transaction costs. If the market cared it would show as dispersion collapsing toward the low end, but NG does not trade on EPS, so the finding is near zero by construction.
findings.independence: The Q2 spend run-rate comes from the 2026-06-24 Q2 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1173420/000117184326004278/0001171843-26-004278-index.htm); the deal-cost leg is inference from the 10-05 press release and the DEFM14A, with no disclosed dollar figure.

findings.finding: The Army Corps released the court-ordered draft Donlin supplemental EIS on 2026-09-23 (it models a 27% tailings-dam failure; 30-day comment period, public hearings Oct 14-19), and the Q3 release and 11:00 ET call are management's first chance to say whether the draft keeps the reaffirm-permits path and the May 2027 final decision on schedule.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print turned on a permitting update in the baseline; the stock fell 6.59% in Toronto on 2026-09-24, the day after the draft, which the coverage attributed to gold (https://wealthawesome.com/why-novagold-resources-inc-stock-plummeted-yesterday-09242026).
findings.why_not_priced: The draft has been public for two weeks, so the document is priced. What is not is the company's read of it: a sell-off that coverage attributed only to gold, on the day after the draft, leaves room for a small relief move if management frames the draft as a reaffirmation path. A reading already in the price would show as no drawdown on 09-24, and there was one.
findings.independence: The timeline (draft in September, final decision by May 2027) is in https://alaskabeacon.com/2026/01/30/feds-begin-to-look-at-the-effects-of-possible-large-spill-at-a-proposed-alaska-mine/. The sign is inference about management framing, and no second document points the same way.

outside_window.finding: The special meeting to vote on the all-share acquisition of Paulson's 40% of Donlin and the redomicile to NovaGold Corporation is on 2026-11-03 (proxy deadline 10-30), and needs 66 2/3% of votes cast. Holders of about 28% have signed voting-support agreements. ISS/Glass Lewis recommendations will come later in October.

Public hearings on the draft Donlin SEIS run Oct 14-19, 2026 in Bethel, Crooked Creek, Aniak and online. The final SEIS and the decision to reaffirm, rescind or modify the federal authorizations come later.

searched_and_found_nothing: EDGAR filing list since the Q2 print (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001173420.json): no 8-K item outside the transaction. The second 10-05 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1173420/000110465926113739/tm2625949d2_8k.htm) only files the existing Calista/TKC/Lyman land agreements as exhibits
Form 4s on 2026-09-03 (nine) and 2026-10-03 (three): a routine-looking monthly cadence, with no open-market cluster found
Proxy-advisor (ISS/Glass Lewis) recommendation or shareholder opposition to the Paulson deal: none found
BFS timing or cost change since Q2 (completion still guided to 2027): nothing new found
Alaska Supreme Court water-quality certification decision: no ruling found since oral arguments
Cause of the 20-day -21% drawdown beyond the gold price: none found in company documents (worth 0 under the rules)

rejected_candidates.candidate: Gold fell 16% over the month to late September, driving NG's 22% slide
rejected_candidates.detail: Describes the run-up the baseline already carries (-21.05% over 20d). It is not information about this print and bears no direction for the window; gold over the window is unpredictable from here.

baseline_tension: Neither finding cuts against the baseline: the call-heavy OI and the -21% run-up are gold positioning, and the company-level items are small and offsetting, so nothing here beats the option-implied move.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (disputed bar, -$0.06 to -$0.09 across aggregators) together with lesson 1 (this name has not traded on its loss line): the Q3 loss finding goes from -0.3 to -0.2, applied once
abs_move_pct raised from the draft's 5.0 to 5.5 under the core's note that hunters' scales run small (option-implied 6.43, own median 5.01); expected_move stays 0 because p_up is 50
The SEIS finding is left at +0.3: it is already sized as a small inference under lesson 5
